blocks.text: Questions? We've got answers. How is the Gummy different from your Multivitamin Capsules, Pro, and Powder? Gummy vs. Multivitamin Capsules (3): Our Gummy (3 per day) and Prenatal Multivitamin Capsules (3 capsules per day) are both easy-to-take formats — it comes down to preference. The Gummy is a simplified 17-nutrient formula with clinically studied dosages of Vitamin D, B6, and Methylfolate, but reduced levels of space-heavy nutrients like Choline, Zinc, and Selenium. The Capsules deliver all 22 nutrients and can be taken alongside a nourishing meal at breakfast or lunch. Gummy vs. Powder: Our Gummy (3 per day) and Prenatal Multivitamin Powder (1 scoop per day) are both easy-to-take formats — it comes down to preference. The Gummy is a simplified 17-nutrient formula with clinically studied dosages of Vitamin D, B6, and Methylfolate, but reduced levels of space-heavy nutrients like Choline, Zinc, and Selenium. The Powder delivers all 22 nutrients and mixes into food or a smoothie. Gummy vs. Pro (8): Our Prenatal Multivitamin Pro (8 per day) is our most comprehensive formula, with optimal levels of 26 essential nutrients. It's designed for optimal support through pregnancy and postpartum, including breastfeeding. The Gummy is for the days a capsule isn't an option. When should I start taking the Prenatal Multivitamin? Take it before, during, after pregnancy — and even beyond — for the more supportive nourishment you need to feel your best and help avoid depletion. We like to stress the importance of preconception nutritional preparation and postpartum recovery, so this product is for you even if you are a few years away from having kids or a few years postpartum. Why does your Prenatal Multivitamin not include Calcium? Calcium is included at 200mg in Prenatal Multivitamin Pro and not included in Prenatal Multivitamin Gummy. The reason for this is nutrient prioritization. Calcium is a key mineral that we recognize as highly important in the perinatal lifestage. Howev
